title: Pipe wall shear stress
line: A steady flow FEA study of the wall shear stress in a 10 mm hydraulic line.
description: Steady laminar flow of ISO VG 46 oil at 40 C through a 10 mm bore, 300 mm long, at 1 L/min. The study returns the wall shear stress on the bore, 6.72 Pa in the developed region by Poiseuille, and its peak in the entrance.
thumbnailAlt: Wall shear stress on the bore of a 10 mm hydraulic line, solved in RunMat
